fact: Niger's civil registry planned to integrate the Numéro unique d'identification (NUI) issued by WURI-Niger into its digital civil-status platform, with a population register to be built under article 74 of law 2019-29, and birth declaration at 65% in 2023.
title: LE SYSTEME DE L'ETAT CIVIL NIGERIEN : Performance, Perspectives et Défis
